script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE HUNGRY GAME

FADE IN:

INT. TECHNOCITY - DAY

An expansive, gleaming metropolis of skyscrapers and towering edifices.
SILICON VALLEY'S GOTHAM CITY.

A modern, open-concept office building, TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS. Inside,
the hum of employees working diligently.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - SALES FLOOR - DAY

JASON, a charismatic, competitive salesman, stands in the center of the room,
addressing his peers.

JASON
(loud, confident)
Another month, another quota met. But we're not here to rest on our
laurels. We're here to climb the ranks. And the only way to do that is to
hunger for more.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - BOARDROOM - DAY

The TECHNOCITY EXECUTIVE TEAM: ANNABEL, JASON, and RICHARD, sit around
the table.

ANNABEL
(serious, stern)
We're launching a new product line. It's a game-changer. And I want the best
of the best on this project.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - SALES FLOOR - DAY

Jason strides through the office, looking for his next mark. He sees
VICTORIA, a talented, hardworking saleswoman.

JASON
(smirking)
Victoria, you've been with the company for years. Haven't you grown tired
of selling the same old product?

VICTORIA
(defensive)
I'm content with my role here. I don't need to compete with you.

JASON
(grinning)
That's what they all say. But the best salespeople know that ambition is the
fire that drives us forward.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - ANNABEL'S OFFICE - NIGHT

Annabel receives a call from the CEO of a rival company. They've poached a
key employee from TechnoCity.

ANNABEL
(angry, defeated)
Why did we let them take him? We could have offered him a better deal.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - SALES FLOOR - DAY

Jason and Victoria sit at their desks, side by side. They exchange glances
and a knowing smile.

VICTORIA
(whispering)
I've been thinking about what you said. Maybe it's time for me to aim higher.

JASON
(grinning)
Welcome to the game.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - BOARDROOM - NIGHT

The Executive Team, along with Jason and Victoria, present their ideas for
the new product line. Annabel is impressed.

ANNABEL
(proud, satisfied)
This is exactly what I was looking for. I'm confident that with your drive
and ambition, we can make this a success.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - SALES FLOOR - DAY

The team works together, collaborating and pushing each other to exceed their
goals. The office buzzes with energy and determination.

---

INT. TECHNOCITY HEADQUARTERS - LOBBY - NIGHT

The team gathers to celebrate their success. They raise a glass to the
future and the hunger that drives them.

JASON
(toasting)
To ambition. To growth. And to the Hungry Game.

---

FADE OUT.

THE END
